dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple closed-loop 'O' and semi-closed 'C' structures exhibit irregular, wavy perimeters with a high-contrast transition from the dark primary pelt to a 1-3 pixel wide light-gray boundary, enclosing a darker central core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low spatial density of solid high-intensity clusters. Most light-colored pixels are constrained to the perimeters of the macro-annuli. A few isolated, solid light-gray circular blobs lack an internal gradient and are situated along the upper dorsal ridge.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A cluster of four prominent macro-annuli in the mid-dorsal region forms an irregular quadrilateral. Further towards the posterior, a group of three smaller annuli forms an approximate scalene triangle relationship.
